evidence.quote: Our bones and teeth are hard tissues that form throughout our lives at different sensitivities and timescales. As they develop, they encode information about lived experiences, including diet, stress, and environmental shifts.
The BSP Lab leverages the developmental principles of hard tissues to explore life history questions pertaining to humankind.
At UCSD, she runs the Bioarchaeology and Skeletal Physiology Lab, which aims to reconstruct life history events through skeletal and dental records.
